title: A-Ma Temple
visualBrief: Two mapped temple controls: main terraced compound with red round-arched front hall, lattice openings, green/grey upturned roof ranges, slender diminishing seven-tier pagoda form and open inner courts; plus the separate northern granite entrance with a genuine open doorway, green tiled cornice, paired ridge ornaments/central pearl, red lanterns, approach steps and simplified guardian lions. Preserve independent buildings and native hillside. Hall allocation, open-court dimensions and terrace/roof subdivision inside the broad mapped compound are picture-led approximations; no exact hidden-room or furnishing inventory.

sourceFacts.horizontalBasis: Exact-QID way192187333/main PMTiles35184564276165 fixes the main compound outline and8.2m height tag. Separate PMTiles35185722933384 about31m north fits the granite entrance/pavilion component seen from the western plaza. Keep both centers, native east/south at heading0 and internal angle+1.472357881276rad. Viewed entrances face local+v/approximately west; photos including a western camera looking east resolve that sign. Internal hall/court subdivision, pagoda center and exact terrace engineering remain approximate.
sourceFacts.architecturalHeights: Mapped8.2m height belongs to the main compound shell; apply approximately to the red front hall roof/ridge above its local terrace. Other range/pavilion heights are picture-led estimates. Pagoda form about10.8m with seven diminishing tiers is a visual simplification, not a certified measured tier inventory. Porcelain figures, guardian anatomy, lettering and fine carving are simplified.

reconstruction.terrainBasis: Pinned standard Protomaps2026-10-14/Mapzen13–14 extract. Retain original native six-meter hillside. Use separate locally sampled level hall/gate terraces with buried bases; the north entrance is a shallow lower gate in front of a higher rear pavilion. No broad flattened podium, terrain/water cutout or neighboring-shell removal.
